content.comment_body: Hello, I am wondering if it is possible to have web access to [product_name] using two different devices at the same time. Is it necessary to log out from the web server before starting a new session? Thank you.

I tested this scenario with both a PC and a tablet. In my experience, the connections on both devices were not consistently stable. I tried it with both a basic and an advanced web server, but disconnections occurred repeatedly. If you want an official response from [company_name], you should submit a support request.

I can confirm that attempting to maintain two sessions from different locations at the same time results in instability. The [product_name] unexpectedly stopped when a second device connected. This happened roughly one out of five tries, which is too frequent to consider it reliable. The device I used was [article_no], not the latest version.

I also tested running two sessions using the basic web server. With a newer [product_name] ([article_no]), I found that it was not possible to maintain two simultaneous connections; I used a PC and a mobile device for testing. Thank you and regards.

Hello everyone, I have encountered the same issue. When multiple connections are made simultaneously (smartphone, tablet, PC, etc.), one user gets disconnected or various error messages occur ("Connection refused", etc.). [company_name], are you aware of this scenario? The [product_name] web editor works well for simple tasks, but users would like to connect several devices—such as in a household with multiple smartphones and tablets. Is there a possibility for an update or similar solution? Thank you for your feedback.
If you want an official answer from [company_name], please submit a support request.
Only one connection to a [product_name] at a time is officially tested and supported. I expect that a second connection will be denied.
Hi, I stopped using [product_name] web editor and switched to Node-RED, which is a much better tool and a complete solution for communication with [product_name] devices. Regards,
Using Node-RED to connect to [product_name] instead of the web editor is worthwhile to learn.
Node-RED does not increase the number of simultaneous connections allowed for a [product_name], right?

Hi [user_name], I just saw your question today. Is there a way to get notified when I receive a new post? Regarding your question: Yes, it is possible. I tested by putting two mobile phones side by side and used a switch on the Node-RED dashboard to control a blind on both devices simultaneously without issues.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users have experienced issues when trying to access a [product_name] device's web interface from multiple devices at once. Connections frequently become unstable, resulting in forced logouts and error messages. The official response from [company_name] clarifies that only one session at a time is supported, and no solutions for concurrent multi-device access exist. This drives some users to look for alternative platform solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] web editor to offer reliable access from multiple devices simultaneously, without being disconnected or needing to log out between sessions. Multi-device functionality is a key desired feature.
